item.title: Indians pay tribute after Arijit retires at 38 as Bollywood singer
item.description: Heartbroken fans of renowned Indian singer Arijit Singh have been paying tribute to him after he announced he would no longer take on new playback assignments, marking the end of a defining chapter in contemporary Bollywood music.Some described his voice as "the sound of our heartbreaks and celebrations", while others called it "a presence in every corner of our lives".In Indian cinema, playback singing refers to studio recordings of songs that actors lip‑sync on screen - a bedrock of Bollywood

item.title: Lawmaker among 15 killed in Colombia plane crash
item.description: A plane crash in northeast Colombia on Wednesday killed all 15 people on board, including a local lawmaker, state-run airline Satena said.The Beechcraft 1900 twin-engined turboprop plane took off before noon from Cucuta, on the border with Venezuela, for a short flight to the town of Ocana, Satena said.Air traffic control lost contact with the plane 12 minutes into the flight, the carrier added.Satena did not say what caused the crash and said the plane's emergency beacon had not been activated.

item.title: Tarique Rahman reaches Rajshahi
item.description: BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman has reached Rajshahi to join a election rally there.He is scheduled to speak at the Rajshahi Madrasa playground rally at 2PMas the chief guest.After a long 22 years, the BNP chief went to the district. He will also spoke in Naogaon and Bogura rallies.From around 9AM, the party supporters began arriving at the venue in trucks and buses from Rajshahi and neighbouring districts, carrying flags, banners and placards.
